test.title: SVG analog clock
test.description: A live analog clock drawn in SVG with tick marks, three hands and a 24-hour digital readout.

judge.guidance: The two screenshots are 2.5 s apart: the digital readout must advance by 2–3 seconds and the second hand must move accordingly. You cannot know the wall-clock time of the screenshots, so check that the code reads the local time from Date and that hand angles are consistent with the readout (the hour hand advances with the minutes). Count the tick marks in the code.

criteria.title: Shows the correct time
criteria.description: Hands and readout are derived from the current local time; hour, minute and second angles are mathematically correct and agree with the digital readout in both screenshots.

criteria.title: Three hands, one-second updates
criteria.description: Distinct hour, minute and second hands (length/width/color differ); the second hand updates every second without drift, skipped seconds or a visible jump backwards at 59→0.

criteria.title: Hour and minute ticks
criteria.description: 12 longer hour ticks and shorter ticks for every other minute (60 positions in total), evenly spaced and correctly aligned with the hands' rotation origin.

criteria.title: Centered, at least 320×320
criteria.description: Exactly one SVG clock, centered horizontally and vertically, rendered at 320×320 px or larger and not clipped at the 1280×800 viewport.

criteria.title: Digital HH:MM:SS readout
criteria.description: The current time appears below the clock in 24-hour HH:MM:SS format with zero padding, updating in sync with the second hand.

criteria.title: Clean light-on-dark design
criteria.description: Light clock elements on a dark background, good contrast and a tidy, deliberate look (consistent stroke widths, a center cap, legible readout); no clutter.

criteria.title: Self-contained, valid, error-free
criteria.description: A single valid HTML5 file with inline CSS and JS only, no external resources, and no JavaScript errors in CHECKS.md.

test.prompt:
Build a self-contained HTML page showing a working analog clock rendered in SVG.

Requirements:
- Single .html file. Inline CSS and JS only. No external resources.
- One SVG analog clock, centered on the page, at least 320x320.
- Hour, minute, and second hands. The second hand updates every 1 second.
- Tick marks for every hour (longer) and every minute (shorter).
- Display the current time digitally below the clock (HH:MM:SS, 24h).
- Use a clean light-on-dark theme.
- Must be valid HTML5. Must not throw any JavaScript errors when loaded.
